integrity.claim_basis: Exact reduction to a signed linear combination of independent standard Cauchy variables, followed by their characteristic-function stability and an exact tail calculation.
integrity.computational_role: Numerical checks are reproducibility checks only and are not used as proof of the all-level statement.
integrity.literature_scope: Primary method text and closely related dependence/calibration papers were compared by statement and implication.

limitations: The theorem assumes independent latent uniform variables across antithetic pairs and deterministic nonnegative weights.
It does not claim the same law under dependence across latent pairs, imperfect complementarity, or truncated Cauchy variants.
The principal originality risk is an elementary equivalent stable-law calculation in unindexed or supplementary material.
title: Exact cancellation budget for Cauchy combination of antithetic p-value pairs
